credit:
INSEE: Populations de référence 2023 (published 18 December 2025; effective 1 January 2026), population municipale, geography 1 January 2025. Source: https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8680726. Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0 (Etalab), https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence/.
Modifications: selected and linked population municipale and its reference year to existing rows for the same entity; conflicting identities, mergers/splits after the stored year and sections without a count held. COG 2026 (INSEE, same licence), geo.api.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte 2.0), and Wikidata (CC0) used for identity checks. Per-record review: .github/fixes-docs/ledgers/fr_pop_v5x.jsonl and fr_pop_v5x.sources.json.

methods.M1: Match literal own P374 (full nondeprecated alternatives where available plus fresh truthy SPARQL index), P31, current COG TYPECOM, exact folded name/native, same departement, parent_id through its own commune code, own Earth point within 10 km; whole communes also within 10 km of official centre. No codes borrowed from parents. Reject code conflicts, former/subentity classes on communes, wrong types, missing own items and absent own counts. Query index is literal-item evidence, not a redirect resolver; archived full items require returned id equal requested id. COG movement history 1943-2026 screens both incoming and outgoing codes; all non-name movement kinds after the stored year are held. Missing years use earliest own P1082 matching-count date; absent that, any recorded territorial history is held. Current commune/delegated/associated/ARM populations use PMUN from their respective INSEE source rows; never EPCI, departement arrondissement or parent count. No stored newer year overwritten. Unresolved keys require v4 unchanged name/native/item/point/state/country, same commune scope and a reviewed event if changed. Holds can include rows numerically agreeing whose identities are unproved. 10 km proximity is corroboration, not polygon containment. All full review evidence and reform rows remain in work/ledger_full_fr_pop_v5x.jsonl.

fields.s: c changed / u unchanged / h held
fields.a: after population/year; omitted when identical to b
fields.n: population CSV member index (0 donnees_communes.csv, 1 donnees_communes_deleguees.csv) and line
